# triangulation.library: LocallyInside

    // True when the segment from `a` towards the vertex at `b` leaves `a` into the
    // ring's interior. Reads only the sector at `a`, so `b` may belong to another
    // ring — which is what the bridge search needs.
    LocallyInside(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>,
        a: Integer, b: Integer): Boolean
    {
        var prev = points.NodePoint(nodes, nodes.At(a).Prev);
        var here = points.NodePoint(nodes, a);
        var next = points.NodePoint(nodes, nodes.At(a).Next);
        var there = points.NodePoint(nodes, b);
        return TwiceSignedArea(prev, here, next) > 0.0
            ? TwiceSignedArea(here, there, next) <= 0.0
                && TwiceSignedArea(here, prev, there) <= 0.0
            : TwiceSignedArea(here, there, prev) > 0.0
                || TwiceSignedArea(here, next, there) > 0.0;
    }

    // The lowest live slot in [start, end), or -1 when every node there is dead.
    // Recomputing the head this way is what lets each pass below take and return
    // the buffer alone.
    FirstLiveSlot(start: Integer, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>, end: Integer): Integer
    {
        var slot = start;
        var found = -1;
        while (slot < end && found < 0)
        {
            if (nodes.At(slot).Active) { found = slot; }
            slot = slot + 1;
        }
        return found;
    }

    // The number of nodes in the ring through `head`. Precondition: head is live.
    RingLength(head: Integer, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>): Integer
    {
        var slot = nodes.At(head).Next;
        var length = 1;
        while (slot != head)
        {
            length = length + 1;
            slot = nodes.At(slot).Next;
        }
        return length;
    }

    // The live slot of the ring through `head` whose point is leftmost.
    LeftmostSlot(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>, head: Integer): Integer
    {
        var best = head;
        var slot = nodes.At(head).Next;
        while (slot != head)
        {
            if (points.NodePoint(nodes, slot).IsFurtherLeft(points.NodePoint(nodes, best)))
            {
                best = slot;
            }
            slot = nodes.At(slot).Next;
        }
        return best;
    }

    //==
    // # Ring construction and cleanup

    // The buffer slot at ring position `i` of the pool range starting at `start`:
    // the pool order when `forward`, the reverse when not. Reversing is how a ring
    // stored the wrong way round is rewound. Precondition: 0 <= i < count.
    RingSlot(start: Integer, count: Integer, forward: Boolean, i: Integer): Integer
        => forward ? start + i : start + count - 1 - i;

    // Links the pool range [start, start + count) into one circular ring, in pool
    // order or reversed.
    LinkRing(start: Integer, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>, count: Integer,
        forward: Boolean): Buffer<EarClipNode>
    {
        var result = nodes;
        var i = 0;
        while (i < count)
        {
            var slot = RingSlot(start, count, forward, i);
            var prev = RingSlot(start, count, forward, (i + count - 1) % count);
            var next = RingSlot(start, count, forward, (i + 1) % count);
            result = result.Set(slot, EarClipNode(VertexIndex(slot), prev, next, true));
            i = i + 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    // Unlinks the node at `slot` from its ring and marks it dead.
    Unlink(slot: Integer, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>): Buffer<EarClipNode>
    {
        var node = nodes.At(slot);
        var prev = nodes.At(node.Prev).WithNext(node.Next);
        var next = nodes.At(node.Next).WithPrev(node.Prev);
        return nodes.Set(node.Prev, prev).Set(node.Next, next).Set(slot, node.Removed);
    }

    // True when the corner at `slot` encloses no area — a repeated vertex, a
    // collinear midpoint, or the tip of a zero-width spike — and so would only ever
    // emit a degenerate triangle.
    IsFlatCorner(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>, slot: Integer): Boolean
        => points.NodePoint(nodes, slot)
                .IsSamePoint(points.NodePoint(nodes, nodes.At(slot).Next))
        || points.CornerTurn(nodes, slot) == 0.0;

    // Drops every flat corner from the ring living in [start, end), and empties a
    // ring that falls below three vertices. Repeats until a full pass changes
    // nothing, because removing one corner can flatten its neighbour. Also the heal
    // pass after bridging, whose slits leave duplicated vertices behind.
    // (earcut's `filterPoints`.)
    FilterRing(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>,
        start: Integer, end: Integer): Buffer<EarClipNode>
    {
        var result = nodes;
        var changed = true;
        while (changed)
        {
            changed = false;
            var head = start.FirstLiveSlot(result, end);
            var length = head < 0 ? 0 : head.RingLength(result);
            var slot = head;
            var visited = 0;
            while (visited < length)
            {
                var next = result.At(slot).Next;
                if (length < 3 || points.IsFlatCorner(result, slot))
                {
                    result = slot.Unlink(result);
                    length = length - 1;
                    changed = true;
                }
                slot = next;
                visited = visited + 1;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
